chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام.
That Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was brought a man who had played with his penis, so he struck his hand until it became red; then he married him from the Bayt al-Mal.

key_terms.بَيْتِ الْمَالِ: the public treasury of the Muslim community
key_terms.عَبِثَ: engaged improperly or toyed in a prohibited sexual manner
key_terms.فَضَرَبَ: so he struck, as a disciplinary measure

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام say about the ruling on masturbation and helping a person marry?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning a man who committed masturbation. It describes both a disciplinary response and subsequent assistance for marriage from the public treasury, indicating a practical approach to restraining wrongdoing and facilitating a lawful outlet.
